timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. Europe/Amsterdam) used to resolve the current time for stations.

weather_city.label: Weather City
weather_city.description: City used to look up the weather forecast for stations that reference it.

weather_country.label: Weather Country
weather_country.description: Country used to look up the weather forecast for stations that reference it.

weather_provider.label: Weather Provider
weather_provider.description: Service used to fetch the weather forecast for stations that reference it.

weather_timeout_seconds.label: Weather Request Timeout
weather_timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for the weather provider to respond, in seconds, before giving up.

user.title: Choose the AI Radio engines
user.description: Pick the AI engine that writes the moderator sections and the text-to-speech engine that voices them.

abort.no_ai_engine: AI Radio needs an AI engine. Set up a plugin that provides AI first, for example the Home Assistant plugin with an AI task entity.
abort.no_tts_engine: AI Radio needs a text-to-speech engine. Set up a plugin that provides text-to-speech first, for example the Home Assistant plugin with a TTS entity.

errors.ai_radio_no_ai_engine: AI Radio cannot start because no AI engine is available. Set up a plugin that provides AI, for example the Home Assistant plugin with an AI task entity.
errors.ai_radio_no_tts_engine: AI Radio cannot start because no text-to-speech engine is available. Set up a plugin that provides text-to-speech, for example the Home Assistant plugin with a TTS entity.
